protocol_name: Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: Shell release, bead capture, ethanol wash and elution chip

events.narration: IR step 22 (release_trap): load the capsules from the hand-off from chip3_filter_lysis_rt_wash: syringe on inlet_1 at 20 uL/min, VENT release_trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 22 (release_trap): release: FEED shell_digesting_enzyme_in (shell_digesting_enzyme) at 20 uL/min, VENT release_trap_waste_out, all else capped. Release the cDNA by digesting the capsule shells with a shell-digesting enzyme.

IR step 23 (beads_1): exchange to magnetic_beads: FEED magnetic_beads_in (magnetic_beads) at 20 uL/min, VENT beads_1_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Bind the library to magnetic beads.
IR step 23 (beads_1): load the nucleic_acid from the hand-off from chip3_filter_lysis_rt_wash: syringe on inlet_1 at 20 uL/min, VENT beads_1_waste_out. Every other port capped.
IR step 23 (beads_1): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 5 min (placeholder time). Bind the library to magnetic beads.

IR step 24 (beads_1): exchange to ethanol_wash: FEED ethanol_wash_in (ethanol_wash) at 20 uL/min, VENT beads_1_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the beads with ethanol wash solution on a magnet.

IR step 25 (beads_1): exchange to elution_buffer: FEED elution_buffer_in (elution_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT beads_1_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Elute the library from the beads in water.
IR step 25 (beads_1): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 2 min (placeholder time). Elute the library from the beads in water.

IR step 25 (beads_1): collect the library: FEED elution_buffer_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip4_shell_release_bead_capture_wash_elution: library after step 25'. Every other port capped.
